title: Pontoon Rentals & Tours

services.name: pontoon boat rental
services.desc: Purple Martin Tour, Sunset Cruise Tour, Graveyard Tour, Island Tour (Fuel Included). A pontoon boat tour on Lake Murray can consist of whatever the group would like to do. The captain can make some suggestions of good areas to swim, lounge, eat lunch or dinner, and sight see. Ultimately, we want you to enjoy your time on Lake Murray. You may also enjoy your own adult beverage, knowing that an experienced, sober captain is at the helm. One of our most popular boat tours is the Purple Martin Tour, which is offered each summer between June and September. The Purple Martin is a bird from the swallow family that migrates from South America nests on the island of Lake Murray each summer evening.
